newsitem.title: USA: Sears names vice president corporate strategy.
newsitem.headline: Sears names vice president corporate strategy.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co on Monday said it named Michael Tower to the new position of vice president of corporate strategy.
Before joining Sears, Tower, 38, was a partner and vice president of A.T. Kearney, based in Chicago. He joined the consulting firm in 1987.
As a consultant, Tower has been involved in Sears' strategic sourcing and organizational realignment efforts during the last few years, the retailer said in a statement.
Tower will report to Alan Lacy, Sears executive vice president and chief financial officer.
